Electric Cab (eCab) Private Charters, Tours & Event Transportation
Explore Austin (and beyond) with Electric Cab (eCab) — a professional electric shuttle and micro-transit fleet built for private charters, guided tours, and seamless event transportation.
Whether you’re planning a corporate event, wedding, festival, conference, or private group outing, eCab provides clean, quiet, fully-insured electric vehicles operated by experienced local drivers who know the city inside and out.
This is not a rideshare — it’s a dedicated fleet reserved exclusively for your group.
What We Offer
Private Charters – Hourly or half-day bookings for groups
Guided or Self-Guided Tours – Custom routes and schedules
Event Transportation – Conferences, weddings, festivals, VIP movement
Group Logistics – Multi-vehicle coordination available
Eco-Friendly Fleet – 100% electric, zero tailpipe emissions
Our vehicles are ideal for downtown areas, campuses, entertainment districts, historic zones, and special events.
